title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Contract Discount on the Loading Surcharge
content:
## Clause

A Dangerous Goods Acceptance category may grant contract holders a percentage discount on its loading surcharge. The discount applies when two things hold together: the category's minimum qualifying rank is not 0, and the customer's contract rank is at least that minimum. When they hold, the discount percentage is the category's figure; otherwise the discount percentage is 0.

## Discount settings per category

| Category | Minimum qualifying contract rank | Discount (percent) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 | 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 5 | 10 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0 | 0 |

## Truth table

| Minimum rank of the category is not 0 | Customer rank at least that minimum | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the category's percentage |
| yes | no | 0 |
| no | any | 0 |

## Cases

- AHL DG Compressed Gases, customer of rank 6: 10 percent.
- AHL DG Compressed Gases, customer of rank 4: no discount.
- AHL DG Special Approval, customer of rank 6: no discount, the category's minimum being 0.
